purpose: Verify unique institute ID is accepted during user creation
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; institute ID does not exist
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; user account created

purpose: Verify duplicate institute ID is rejected during user creation
preconditions: User with institute_id 'BR001_DUP' already exists
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; rejection with validation error

purpose: Verify existing institute ID is immutable and cannot be altered
preconditions: User exists with institute_id 'BR001_IMM'
action_or_input: PATCH/PUT attempting to modify institute_id to 'BR001_NEW'
expected_result: Institute ID remains unchanged ('BR001_IMM')

purpose: Verify user creation with valid institute email domain
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; unique institute email provided
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; email saved

purpose: Verify user creation with invalid non-institute email domain is rejected
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; non-institute email rejected

purpose: Verify malformed email string without domain is rejected
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; invalid email format rejected

purpose: Verify creation with all mandatory user-type fields present
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; complete student payload
action_or_input: POST /api/super-admin/users with first_name, last_name, email, institute_id, user_type='student'
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; complete user record persisted

purpose: Verify creation missing mandatory fields is rejected
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated
action_or_input: POST /api/super-admin/users with missing user_type or missing name
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; missing mandatory fields error

purpose: Verify creation with invalid user_type outside allowed choices is rejected
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; invalid user_type rejected

purpose: Verify deactivated user who meets archival criteria is successfully archived
preconditions: User is in 'deactivated' state
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; status updated to 'archived'

purpose: Verify active user cannot be directly archived without prior deactivation
preconditions: User is currently 'active'
action_or_input: PATCH /api/super-admin/users/<id>/status with status='archived' directly from active
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; direct archival of active user prohibited

purpose: Verify restoration of archived user within reversible window
preconditions: User archived within allowed window (< 30 days)
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; user restored from archive

purpose: Verify restoration is blocked after reversibility window expires
preconditions: User archived beyond reversible window (> 30 days) marked non-restorable
action_or_input: Restoration request for expired archived user
expected_result: Restoration prohibited; permanent archive status preserved

purpose: Verify user can hold multiple compatible concurrent roles
preconditions: User has active role 'tutor'
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; user holds both active roles concurrently

purpose: Verify concurrent assignment of mutually conflicting roles is rejected
preconditions: User holds 'internal_auditor' role
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; conflict error rejected

purpose: Verify singular role assignment when role is currently vacant
preconditions: Singular role 'dean_academics' has no active holder
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; role successfully assigned

purpose: Verify assigning occupied singular role to a second holder is rejected
preconditions: Singular role 'dean_academics' already actively held by User A
action_or_input: POST /api/super-admin/roles/assign with role_name='dean_academics' to User B
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; singular role duplicate occupancy rejected

purpose: Verify role assignment with valid start_date and future end_date
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; eligible user
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; assignment created with valid dates

purpose: Verify role assignment with inverted dates (start_date > end_date) is rejected
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; inverted dates rejected

purpose: Verify permanent role may omit end_date
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated; permanent role assignment
action_or_input: POST /api/super-admin/roles/assign with start_date='2026-01-01' and null end_date
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; permanent assignment created

purpose: Verify role past its end date is considered expired and inactive
preconditions: Role assignment exists with past end_date ('2025-01-01')
expected_result: Role is marked inactive / expired; access revoked

purpose: Verify future-dated role with start_date in future is not yet active
preconditions: Role assignment exists with future start_date ('2027-01-01')
action_or_input: Check role effective activity status prior to start date
expected_result: Role remains scheduled and not currently active

purpose: Verify assigning faculty role to faculty user is permitted
preconditions: User has user_type='faculty'
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; faculty role assigned to faculty

purpose: Verify assigning administrative/faculty role to student is prohibited
preconditions: User has user_type='student'
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; ineligible user_type rejected

purpose: Verify non-conflicting role assignments are permitted simultaneously
preconditions: User has active role 'course_instructor'
expected_result: HTTP 201 Created; non-conflicting roles coexist

purpose: Verify conflicting role assignment is rejected with conflict details
preconditions: User has active role 'procurement_officer'
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; conflict validation prevents assignment

purpose: Verify role reassignment transfers active tenure from old holder to new holder
preconditions: User A holds role 'dean_students'
expected_result: Old holder's assignment closed; new holder granted active assignment

purpose: Verify previous role holder retains read-only access to their past actions
preconditions: User was previously 'dean_academics'; tenure ended
action_or_input: User accesses audit logs for actions taken during their tenure
expected_result: Read-only access granted; operational edit access revoked

purpose: Verify standard role revocation sets is_active=False
preconditions: User has an active role assignment
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; role assignment marked is_active=False

purpose: Verify revoking an already revoked/inactive role assignment is rejected
preconditions: Role assignment already revoked (is_active=False)
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request; already inactive role cannot be revoked

purpose: Verify deactivation of user account revokes all active role assignments
preconditions: User has active account and 2 active role assignments
expected_result: User account deactivated; effective role access terminated

purpose: Verify valid extension of active role end date
preconditions: Active role assignment with end_date '2026-06-30'
expected_result: End date updated to '2026-12-31'; validity extended

purpose: Verify extending role with invalid end date prior to start date is rejected
preconditions: Active role assignment with start_date '2026-01-01'
action_or_input: Attempt to extend with new end_date '2025-12-31'
expected_result: Rejection; extension date cannot precede start date

purpose: Verify eligible historical operational records can be archived
preconditions: Historical academic batch records closed and inactive
action_or_input: Archival request for closed historical batch
expected_result: Archival permitted; records moved to archive storage

purpose: Verify audit logs are strictly excluded from archival
preconditions: System audit log records exist
action_or_input: Attempt to archive system audit logs
expected_result: Operation rejected; audit logs immutable and non-archivable

purpose: Verify archival proceeds when pre-archival backup succeeds
preconditions: Pre-archival backup completes verified checksum
expected_result: Archival proceeds and commits successfully

purpose: Verify archival aborts if pre-archival backup fails
preconditions: Pre-archival backup simulation returns failure
expected_result: Archival aborted; active data untouched

purpose: Verify purge is prevented before archive retention period has elapsed
preconditions: Archived records with retention period ending 2030
expected_result: Purge request rejected; retention period enforced

purpose: Verify archived data permits read-only search and retrieval
preconditions: Archived records exist in repository
action_or_input: Search and view query on archived records
expected_result: Read-only result returned successfully

purpose: Verify direct write or modification of archived records is prohibited
preconditions: Archived user record exists
action_or_input: Direct update/edit to archived record content
expected_result: Operation prohibited; archived state is immutable

purpose: Verify purge request is accepted for retention-expired archived data
preconditions: Archived dataset whose retention policy has expired
action_or_input: Submit purge request for expired dataset
expected_result: Purge request accepted and queued for dual authorization

purpose: Verify purge request for unexpired archived data is rejected
preconditions: Archived dataset still within active retention period
action_or_input: Submit purge request for unexpired dataset
expected_result: Purge request rejected; retention constraint error

purpose: Verify permanent purge executes only when both Super Admin and IT Head approve
preconditions: Purge request initiated by Super Admin; IT Head supplies second signature
expected_result: Dual authorization verified; permanent purge executed

purpose: Verify purge execution is blocked with only single authorization
preconditions: Purge request has only Super Admin initiation; no IT Head approval
expected_result: Purge execution blocked; missing second authorization

purpose: Verify role assignment queues notification within specified time window
preconditions: Super Admin assigns role to user
expected_result: Role assigned; notification event created for delivery

purpose: Verify security alert is triggered when consecutive failed logins reach 5
preconditions: User account experiences 5 consecutive failed logins
expected_result: Security alert generated and dispatched to configured channels

purpose: Verify security alert is not triggered when failed logins are below threshold (4)
preconditions: User account experiences 4 consecutive failed logins
expected_result: Failed attempt logged; threshold alert not yet triggered

purpose: Verify system audit log is created upon Super Admin actions
preconditions: Super Admin creates a user account
expected_result: SystemAuditLog record exists with action, actor, timestamp

purpose: Verify direct deletion or alteration of audit log entries is blocked
preconditions: Audit log entry exists in database
expected_result: Operation prohibited; audit logs are strictly append-only

purpose: Verify Super Admin can access module control-plane and metadata
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK; administrative control-plane data returned

purpose: Verify Super Admin cannot access operational student grading data
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated in SA scope
action_or_input: Direct access attempt to student module gradebook contents
expected_result: Access denied; control plane isolated from academic operational content

purpose: Verify valid Super Admin credentials establish an authenticated session
preconditions: Valid credentials and active super admin account
expected_result: Session established; access to SA endpoints allowed

purpose: Verify unauthenticated requests to Super Admin endpoints are denied
preconditions: Unauthenticated client (no credentials/session)
expected_result: HTTP 401 Unauthorized / 403 Forbidden; access denied

purpose: Verify Super Admin cannot alter or revoke their own Super Admin status via module
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated as User SA1
action_or_input: POST /api/super-admin/roles/<id>/revoke targeting self Super Admin role
expected_result: Rejection; self-modification of Super Admin status is prohibited

purpose: Verify critical operation executes when accompanied by valid confirmation/reauth
preconditions: Super Admin session active; confirmation token provided
action_or_input: Execute critical operation (e.g. permanent purge request) with valid confirmation
expected_result: Operation succeeds and audit logged

purpose: Verify critical operation is rejected without valid confirmation/reauthentication
preconditions: Super Admin session active; confirmation omitted or invalid
expected_result: Operation rejected; critical confirmation required

purpose: Verify bulk operation within upper limit (<= 1000 records) is accepted
preconditions: Super Admin uploads batch with 500 records
expected_result: Batch validated and processed successfully

purpose: Verify bulk operation exceeding 1000 records is rejected
preconditions: Batch containing 1001 records submitted
expected_result: Operation rejected; batch size exceeds 1000 limit

purpose: Verify password change according to configured rotation policy
preconditions: Super Admin account due for rotation
expected_result: Password updated; rotation timestamp refreshed

purpose: Verify login is restricted if password has expired beyond rotation grace period
preconditions: Account password expired beyond rotation limit
expected_result: Access blocked; password change required

purpose: Verify notification dispatch routes via configured institutional channels
preconditions: Event triggering notification occurs (user creation/role change)
expected_result: Notification queued for institutional email channel

purpose: Verify audit log entries contain all mandatory schema fields
preconditions: Audit log entry generated
expected_result: Each audit entry contains actor, action, timestamp, and details

purpose: Verify user with active role can access authorized resources
preconditions: User has valid active role assignment
action_or_input: User accesses resource permitted by the active role
expected_result: Access granted; role permissions enforced

purpose: Verify user cannot access resources of an inactive or revoked role
preconditions: User role assignment has is_active=False
action_or_input: User attempts to access resource of revoked role
expected_result: Access denied; inactive role permissions not recognized

purpose: Verify updating system parameters within permitted whitelist
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated
action_or_input: Configure permitted parameters (e.g. session timeout = 30 mins)
expected_result: Configuration saved successfully

purpose: Verify attempting to update parameters outside permitted boundary is rejected
preconditions: Super Admin authenticated
action_or_input: Attempt to configure academic calendar or unauthorized module parameters
expected_result: Rejected; modification outside permitted boundary prohibited
